meta.title: Padel Career Simulator
meta.description: Start at 16, grind from FIP Bronze to Premier Padel, and see how your career ends. A full career takes two minutes.

disclaimer.full: Unofficial fan-made simulator. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to the FIP, Premier Padel, or any player. Rankings, names and calendars are real public data; all ratings and attributes are invented estimates for gameplay only.

landing.title: Padel Career Simulator
landing.tagline: You start at 16 with nothing but potential. Pick your side, pick your partner, and find out how far you get.

creator.title: Define your identity
creator.subtitle: Everything here changes how you play — and what you are worth at 16.
creator.handHint: Left-handers are prized on the revés.
creator.sideHint: Tap the court to choose your wall.
creator.driveHint: Right side. The finisher — remate and víbora.
creator.revesHint: Left side. The playmaker — bandeja and defensa.

style.allcourtHint: All-court. Slower to peak, higher ceiling.

creator.seedHint: Drives the whole career. Reroll for a different run, or paste a seed to replay someone else's.

train_harder.title: Train harder
train_harder.description: Your coach wants an extra block this month. Your legs are already talking.

results.gain: The work landed. You come out sharper.
results.small: A small gain, and a lot of sweat.
results.tweak: You tweaked something. It will need a few weeks.
results.rested: You come back fresh and swinging freely.

injury_knock.title: A knock
injury_knock.description: Something in your shoulder is not right. There is a tournament on Thursday.

results.rested: Boring, and exactly right. You heal clean.
results.held_up: It held up. You got away with one.
results.worsened: It went. You are out for a while.

partner_tension.title: Tension with {partner}
partner_tension.description: {partner} has been short with you since the last early exit.

results.resolved: A long dinner, and you are a team again.
results.awkward: It is not fixed, but it is not worse.
results.festered: It festered. You are barely speaking.

wildcard_offer.title: Wildcard offer
wildcard_offer.description: A bigger event has a wildcard with your name on it. It is a long flight.

results.deep_run: You made a run nobody expected. People noticed.
results.early_exit: Out in the first round, and a very long flight home.
results.declined: You stay home and keep your legs.

technique_tweak.title: Technique tweak
technique_tweak.description: Your coach wants to rebuild one shot from the ground up. It will get worse before it gets better.

results.stuck: It stuck. The shot is a weapon now.
results.failed: It never felt right. You go back to the old one.
results.kept: You trust what you have. Confidence is a shot too.

prioritize.title: Pick your peak
prioritize.description: You cannot be sharp everywhere. Where do you point the season?

results.peaked: You timed it perfectly and arrived flying.
results.flat: You peaked a week early and arrived flat.
results.spread: No peaks, no troughs, and fresher legs.

finish_school.title: Finish school
finish_school.description: You can sit your final exams this year, or go full-time on tour now.

results.graduated: You graduate. You also missed a block of training.
results.committed: All in. There is no plan B now.

media_moment.title: The microphone
media_moment.description: A reporter asks what you really think about the seeding.

results.loved: The clip travels. Suddenly everyone knows your name.
results.backlash: The clip travels. You wish it had not.
results.measured: A forgettable answer, and a quiet week.

shady_edge.title: An edge
shady_edge.description: Someone offers you an edge that would not survive a test. Nobody would know. Until they did.

results.undetected: Nothing happens. You play the best padel of your life, and sleep badly.
results.caught: You are caught. The ban costs you your ranking, your money and your name.
results.declined: You walk away and think about it for a long time.

sponsor_deal.title: Sponsor offer
sponsor_deal.description: Two brands want you. One pays properly and expects results.

results.signed: Signed. The money is real and so is the pressure.
results.declined: You keep your own name on your shirt.

hire_coach.title: Build your team
hire_coach.description: You can finally afford someone. One person, this year.

results.hired_coach: A coach who actually watches your matches. You improve faster now.
results.hired_physio: A physio on call. Your body will thank you at 32.
results.declined: You keep the money and do it yourself.

rest_year.title: Manage the load
rest_year.description: You are not 24 any more. A lighter season would buy you years.

results.managed: Fewer events, fresher body, better padel when it counts.
results.held_level: You played it all and held your level. Just.
results.burned_out: You played it all and your body sent the bill.

switch_band.title: Which circuit?
switch_band.description: You choose where you compete next season. Big fish, or deep water?

options.move_pro: Step up to FIP Gold / Platinum
options.drop_pro: Drop back to FIP Gold / Platinum

results.moved_up: Premier Padel. Every draw is a war now.
results.moved_pro: Gold and Platinum. A real step up.
results.dropped: Back down. Winnable draws, smaller cheques.

partner_market.title: The partner market
partner_market.description: The window is open. {partner} is waiting to hear from you.
partner_market.description_dumped: {partner} has taken a better offer. You need someone for next season.

results.accepted: New partner, new wall, everything to prove.
results.stayed: You stay together. The chemistry keeps building.

result.title: Career complete
result.seasonsTogether: {count, plural, =1 {# season together} other {# seasons together}}

tier.journeymanBlurb: You made a living from padel. Most never do.
tier.contenderBlurb: You were in the conversation, and on the big courts.
tier.championBlurb: You won things that matter. People remember the finals.
tier.legendBlurb: You were the era. Everyone else was playing for second.
